trackEntries.musicalCharacter: Gentle questioning melody with layered vocal harmonies and a distinctive flute intro.
trackEntries.albumContext: Opening track of a concept album documented by album-level sources as part of Gaye's socially conscious early-1970s work.
trackEntries.historicalContext: Album-level sources place the recording during 1970 and 1971 sessions in Detroit and West Hollywood.
trackEntries.listeningNotes: Listen for the distinctive flute intro and Marvin's layered vocal harmonies creating a choir-like effect.

trackEntries.listeningNotes: Notice how the stripped-back arrangement places the lyrics at the centre.
